slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single record at SRAM 0x0; accepted iff u32_le at offset 0 == 0x89F066C6 (FUN_08000418 magic compare); no backup copy or fallback exists. Bytes 0x6D8..0x7FFF unused (0xFF).

checksums.name: none_found_verify_after_write_only
checksums.formula_detail: No arithmetic checksum exists: writer FUN_0800036c stores a constant magic and copies globals at 0x6D0/0x6D4 with no loop over the payload; driver FUN_08015174 is a pure byte copy. Integrity = magic equality on load (FUN_08000418) + verify-after-write byte compare via FUN_080151e4(RAM,0x0E000000,0x6D8) whose result is forwarded by FUN_0800036c. Falsified candidates on cap-01 payload [0x04:0x6D8] (all zero): sum8=0x00, sum16=0x0000, xor8=0x00, crc32=0xc1639373, crc32(zeroed magic)=0x05281c85, crc16-modbus=0x0b85; none matches stored u32_le@0 0x89f066c6 (the constant magic) and no non-zero stored checksum slot exists.

io_driver_functions.notes: SRAM byte-copy write: WAITCNT-style preamble (*_DAT & mask | 3), then *dst++=*src++ loop. Call: FUN_08015174(RAM_struct,0x0E000000,0x6D8).
SRAM read via stack-copied SRAM_V112 routine tail-calling FUN_0801528c(src,dst,len,stack). Call: FUN_08015110(0x0E000000,RAM_struct,0x6D8).
Verify-after-write byte compare (not an arithmetic checksum): FUN_080151e4(RAM,0x0E000000,0x6D8); result uVar3 forwarded by writer to unrecovered jumptable continuation.

Save writer/serializer: lock FUN_08014338, store magic @0, global u32 @0x6D0, global byte @~0x6D4, flush via 0x08015174, verify via 0x080151e4, unlock FUN_08014384. No callers in callgraph; reached via unrecovered jumptable.
Save reader/deserializer: read via 0x08015110, magic gate at *piVar1, export u32 @0x6D0 and byte @0x6D4 to globals. No callers in callgraph; reached via unrecovered jumptable.
Lock/guard entry bracketing SRAM write (global +=10, SWI 0xB via FUN_080150e0); paired with unlock FUN_08014384 (global -=10). Textual func_ edge; absent from callgraph.json.
Unlock/guard exit bracketing SRAM write; paired with FUN_08014338.
Unrecovered SRAM_V112 transfer trampoline invoked with (src,dst,len,stack_ptr); body not recoverable in this packet.
